procedures.title: DST810 Speed Calibration Using CAST App
steps: Calibrate speed at 5 different heel angles
Calibrate speed at up to 10 different speeds
Save calibrations to DST810's internal storage
procedures.expected_outcome: Calibrated speed data available across NMEA 2000 network

procedures.title: DST810 Basic Configuration
procedures.expected_outcome: DST810 configured with basic settings

procedures.title: Display Data and Attitude Calibration
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly calibrated attitude measurements and accurate data display

procedures.title: DST810 Basic Speed Calibration
preconditions: CAST app installed on mobile device
steps: Open CAST app on mobile device
Follow app prompts for speed calibration
procedures.expected_outcome: Accurate speed-through-water measurements from 0.3 to 45 knots

procedures.title: Advanced Heel-Compensated Speed Calibration
preconditions: CAST app installed on mobile device
steps: Open CAST app on mobile device
Enter manual speed entries for multiple heel angles
Input up to 10 different speed points
Verify calibration across all heel angles
procedures.expected_outcome: Accurate speed readings across multiple heel angles and speed ranges

procedures.title: Sensor Data Verification
preconditions: DST810 Smart Multisensor installed and powered
steps: Verify heel and trim data from attitude sensor
Confirm all data displaying on navigation system
procedures.expected_outcome: All sensor data streams functioning and reporting correctly

procedures.title: Paddlewheel Installation Requirements
preconditions: Suitable hull location with deadrise up to 22°
steps: Ensure mounting location can support weight (0.9-1.9kg depending on material)
Verify depth range requirements are within 0.5m to 100m
Confirm operating temperature range is within -10°C to 40°C
Install with proper pressure rating consideration (3m max)
Connect to NMEA 2000® network with standard 6m DeviceNet cable
Verify power draw is less than 200mA
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly installed paddlewheel providing accurate speed readings from 0.3 to 45 knots

procedures.title: Wireless Connection Setup
preconditions: Device with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) capability
procedures.expected_outcome: Successfully established wireless connection with paddlewheel sensor

procedures.title: Temperature Sensor Calibration
steps: Verify sensor reading against known reference temperature
procedures.expected_outcome: Accurate temperature readings within ±0.5°C tolerance

procedures.title: Data Protocol Configuration
steps: Confirm PGN 060928 for ISO Address Claim
Configure PGN 126208 for Group Function Acknowledgement
Set up PGN 126464 for Transmit List Functions
Configure PGN 128259 for Water Speed Reference
Set PGN 128267 for Water Depth with Transducer Offset
Configure PGNs 130310-130312 for Water Temperature Parameters
Set PGN 130316 for Extended Range Temperature
procedures.expected_outcome: All NMEA 2000 PGNs properly configured for data transmission

procedures.title: Transducer Insert Removal
procedures.expected_outcome: Transducer insert removed with minimal water ingress
